subject.title: Bug:  ignores  config and returns success on media failure

question: Should Feishu media upload allowlist failures use the shared filesystem/media root policy only, add a Feishu-specific mediaLocalRoots config surface, or keep text fallback as normal success?
rationale: This cannot be safely resolved by cleanup automation because it changes host-file upload permissions and user-visible delivery status semantics.

options.title: Use shared media policy and explicit failure status
options.body: Keep host path permission under the shared filesystem/media access policy and change Feishu allowlist/upload failures to hard-fail or return typed partial success instead of ordinary success.

options.title: Add Feishu-specific mediaLocalRoots
options.body: Add a documented Feishu config key with schema/tests and an explicit security review for the host-path expansion it grants.

options.title: Document fallback as intended
options.body: Keep fallback text delivery as a successful send only if maintainers explicitly accept that Feishu media upload failure means link fallback delivery, not attachment delivery.

recommendation.title: Use shared media policy and explicit failure status
recommendation.body: Keep host path permission under the shared filesystem/media access policy and change Feishu allowlist/upload failures to hard-fail or return typed partial success instead of ordinary success.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the shared outbound media access policy that steipete recently centralized and the Feishu-specific adapter behavior.
